transport: Playwright APIRequestContext GET requests from the local environment
request_variation: Separate anonymous contexts, changing only the userAgent option; no authenticated cookies, origin bypass or security-setting changes

status_by_user_agent.label: Googlebot string only; not a verified Google crawler

denial_response.title: Access denied | nscalculators.com used Cloudflare to restrict access | nscalculators.com | Cloudflare

google_search_console.source: Signed-in visible Sitemaps report, read only

decisions: Do not interpret a Python-user-agent denial alone as verified Googlebot failure.
Do not treat a Googlebot user-agent string sent from this environment as a real Google crawler or proof of current crawl access.
Retain the current sitemap and canonical configuration; no resubmission or account/security change is justified by this evidence.
The current 303-URL sitemap includes the new ownership tool; the October 23 report predates it and does not yet confirm its discovery or indexing.
limitations: One environment and observation time, not a geographic or comprehensive crawler availability audit.
Cloudflare-branded denial does not identify the responsible rule without account logs.
Successful sitemap reading does not prove every page is crawled or indexed.
No traffic gain or daily-goal attainment is inferred.
